From ccc14c6cfd346e85c3ecb970975afd5132763437 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Chunfeng Yun <chunfeng.yun@mediatek.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2021 10:54:22 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] usb: xhci-mtk: fix list_del warning when enable list debug

There is warning of 'list_del corruption' when enable list debug
(CONFIG_DEBUG_LIST=y), fix it by using list_del_init()

Fixes: 4ce186665e7c ("usb: xhci-mtk: Do not use xhci's virt_dev in drop_endpoint")
Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Chunfeng Yun <chunfeng.yun@mediatek.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211209025422.17108-1-chunfeng.yun@mediatek.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-mtk-sch.c b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-mtk-sch.c
index 1edef7527c11..edbfa82c6565 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/host/xhci-mtk-sch.c
+++ b/drivers/usb/host/xhci-mtk-sch.c
@@ -781,7 +781,7 @@ int xhci_mtk_check_bandwidth(struct usb_hcd *hcd, struct usb_device *udev)
 
 	ret = xhci_check_bandwidth(hcd, udev);
 	if (!ret)
-		INIT_LIST_HEAD(&mtk->bw_ep_chk_list);
+		list_del_init(&mtk->bw_ep_chk_list);
 
 	return ret;
 }
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/usb/host/xhci-mtk-sch.c`**
   - The line `INIT_LIST_HEAD(&mtk->bw_ep_chk_list);` was modified to `list_del_init(&mtk->bw_ep_chk_list);` within the `xhci_mtk_check_bandwidth` function.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a warning related to 'list_del corruption' that occurs when list debugging is enabled. By changing the initialization of the list from `INIT_LIST_HEAD` to `list_del_init`, the patch ensures that the list is properly handled when an endpoint is dropped, thus preventing potential corruption and maintaining the integrity of the list structure. This change is directly related to the previous commit that introduced the issue, as indicated by the Fixes tag in the patch.
